facts.title: Clouds Piled Into Mountains
facts.hook: Clouds driven gently, joined together, then piled into “mountains” that hold hail.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًۭا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَامًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍۢ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٍۢ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِۦ يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

tr.en: Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together, then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightening almost takes away the eyesight.
tr.uz: Аллоҳ булутларни ҳайдашини, сўнгра бирга тўплашини, сўнгра уйиб қўйишини кўрмаяпсанми?! Бас, унинг орасидан ёмғир чиқаётганини кўрурсан. У зот осмондан, ундаги тоғлардан дўл тушириб, у билан Ўзи хоҳлаган кишиларга мусибат етказур ва уни Ўзи хоҳлаган кишилардан буриб юборур. Унинг чақмоғининг ярқираши кўзларни кетказгудек бўлур.
tr.ru: Разве ты не видишь, что Аллах гонит облака, потом соединяет их, потом превращает их в кучу облаков, и ты видишь, как из расщелин ее изливается ливень. Он низвергает град с гор, которые на небе. Он поражает им, кого пожелает, и отвращает его, от кого пожелает. Блеск их молний готов унести зрение.
tr.tr: Bilmez misiniz ki, Allah bulutları sürer, sonra onları bir araya getirir; üstüste yığar, sen de onların arasından yağmur yağdığını görürsün. Gökten içinde dolu bulunan dağlar gibi bulutlar indirir, dilediğini ona uğratır, dilediğinden de uzak tutar. Bu bulutların şimşeğinin parıltısı nerdeyse gözleri alır!
tr.fr: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah pousse les nuages? Ensuite Il les réunit et Il en fait un amas, et tu vois la pluie sortir de son sein. Et Il fait descendre du ciel, de la grêle [provenant] des nuages [comparables] à des montagnes. Il en frappe qui Il veut et l'écarte de qui Il veut. Peu s'en faut que l'éclat de son éclair ne ravisse la vue.
tr.id: Tidaklah kamu melihat bahwa Allah mengarak awan, kemudian mengumpulkan antara (bagian-bagian)nya, kemudian menjadikannya bertindih-tindih, maka kelihatanlah olehmu hujan keluar dari celah-celahnya dan Allah (juga) menurunkan (butiran-butiran) es dari langit, (yaitu) dari (gumpalan-gumpalan awan seperti) gunung-gunung, maka ditimpakan-Nya (butiran-butiran) es itu kepada siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya dan dipalingkan-Nya dari siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya. Kilauan kilat awan itu hampir-hampir menghilangkan penglihatan.
tr.ur: کیا تم نے نہیں دیکھا کہ خدا ہی بادلوں کو چلاتا ہے، اور ان کو آپس میں ملا دیتا ہے، پھر ان کو تہ بہ تہ کردیتا ہے، پھر تم دیکھتے ہو کہ بادل میں سے مینہ نکل (کر برس) رہا ہے اور آسمان میں جو (اولوں کے) پہاڑ ہیں، ان سے اولے نازل کرتا ہے تو جس پر چاہتا ہے اس کو برسا دیتا ہے اور جس سے چاہتا ہے ہٹا دیتا ہے۔ اور بادل میں جو بجلی ہوتی ہے اس کی چمک آنکھوں کو خیرہ کرکے بینائی کو اُچکے لئے جاتی ہے
tr.bn: তুমি কি দেখ না যে, আল্লাহ মেঘমালাকে সঞ্চালিত করেন, অতঃপর তাকে পুঞ্জীভূত করেন, অতঃপর তাকে স্তরে স্তরে রাখেন; অতঃপর তুমি দেখ যে, তার মধ্য থেকে বারিধারা নির্গত হয়। তিনি আকাশস্থিত শিলাস্তুপ থেকে শিলাবর্ষণ করেন এবং তা দ্বারা যাকে ইচ্ছা আঘাত করেন এবং যার কাছ থেকে ইচ্ছা, তা অন্যদিকে ফিরিয়ে দেন। তার বিদ্যুৎঝলক দৃষ্টিশক্তি যেন বিলীন করে দিতে চায়।
tr.de: Siehst du nicht, daß Allah die Wolken sanft bewegt, sie hierauf zusammenfügt und hierauf zu einem Haufen macht? Dann siehst du den (Platz)regen dazwischen herauskommen. Und Er sendet vom Himmel (Wolken)berge herab, mit Hagel darin, dann trifft Er damit, wen Er will, und wendet ihn ab, von wem Er will. Das Aufleuchten Seines Blitzes nimmt beinahe das Augenlicht.

science: A storm cloud (cumulonimbus) grows in just this order. Small cumulus cells are pushed together by wind and convergence, merge, and stack into a tower up to 12–20 km tall: a cloud “mountain”. Rain and hail fall from deep inside the mass.
Inside, updrafts stronger than 100 km/h carry water droplets up to freezing levels, where they turn to ice, get coated layer by layer and finally fall as hail.
Understanding how small clouds merge into big storm clouds was built up from radar, aircraft and satellite observations in the 20th century.

proof.title: Howard: naming the clouds
proof.text: Luke Howard classifies clouds as cumulus, stratus and cirrus. His names are still used.

proof.title: The Thunderstorm Project
proof.text: The first big US field study flies aircraft and radar into thunderstorms and shows how a storm cell grows, matures and rains out.

proof.title: Cloud merging
proof.text: Radar studies led by Joanne Simpson show that neighbouring cumulus clouds that merge produce more rain than when they stay apart.

proof.title: Doppler radar
proof.text: Doppler radar networks track the winds inside storms and measure updrafts above 100 km/h, which carry hail up and down until it grows too heavy.

media.caption: Towering thunderclouds seen from the ISS.

fits: The sequence matches: clouds driven gently, joined, stacked, then rain from within.
“Mountains” of cloud holding hail matches cumulonimbus towers.
The same verse mentions lightning, and thunderstorms make both hail and lightning.
gaps: Some commentators read “mountains in the sky” as mountains of hail or as heavenly mountains, not cloud towers.
Cloud merging is not named; the verse gives what people can see.
Rain falling from within a cloud is something anyone can watch.

media.caption: Towering thunderclouds seen from the ISS.
A cumulonimbus cloud lit by the setting Sun.
Hailstones.
Time-lapse: cumulus clouds merging and growing into cumulonimbus.

facts.title: A Barrier Between Two Seas
facts.hook: Two seas meet side by side, and between them a barrier that neither crosses.

verses.ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا

tr.en: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
tr.uz: У икки денгизни-буниси чучук-ширин, униси шўр-аччиқ қилиб оқизиб қўйган ва ораларига кўринмас тўсиқ ҳамда очилмас сарҳад қилган Зотдир. (Барча уммонлар ва денгизлар шўр, дарёлар чучук. Дарёлар оқиб бориб сувини денгизларга, уммонларга қуяди. Аммо бу билан денгиз суви чучук бўлиб қолмайди, дарё суви шўр бўлиб қолмайди. Зотан, дарёларнинг суви ҳам денгиз ва уммонлардан буғланиб кўтарилган сувдан иборат.)
tr.ru: Он - Тот, Кто смешал два моря (вида воды): одно - приятное, пресное, а другое - соленое, горькое. Он установил между ними преграду и непреодолимое препятствие.
tr.tr: Birinin suyu tatlı ve kolay içimli, diğerininki tuzlu ve acı olan iki denizi salıverip aralarına da, karışmalarına engel olan bir sınır koyan Allah'tır.
tr.fr: Et c'est Lui qui donne libre cours aux deux mers: l'une douce, rafraîchissante, l'autre salée, amère. Et Il assigne entre les deux une zone intermédiaire et un barrage infranchissable.
tr.id: Dan Dialah yang membiarkan dua laut yang mengalir (berdampingan); yang ini tawar lagi segar dan yang lain asin lagi pahit; dan Dia jadikan antara keduanya dinding dan batas yang menghalangi.
tr.ur: اور وہی تو ہے جس نے دو دریاؤں کو ملا دیا ایک کا پانی شیریں ہے پیاس بجھانے والا اور دوسرے کا کھاری چھاتی جلانے والا۔ اور دونوں کے درمیان ایک آڑ اور مضبوط اوٹ بنادی
tr.bn: তিনিই সমান্তরালে দুই সমুদ্র প্রবাহিত করেছেন, এটি মিষ্ট, তৃষ্ণা নিবারক ও এটি লোনা, বিস্বাদ; উভয়ের মাঝখানে রেখেছেন একটি অন্তরায়, একটি দুর্ভেদ্য আড়াল।
tr.de: Und Er ist es, Der den beiden Meeren freien Lauf läßt: Das eine ist süß und erfrischend, das andere salzig und (auf der Zunge) brennend. Und Er hat zwischen ihnen beiden ein trennendes Hindernis und eine verwehrte Absperrung errichtet.

verses.ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

tr.en: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
tr.uz: Дарё-денгизларни бир-бири билан учрашадиган қилиб қўйди.
tr.ru: Он смешал два моря, которые встречаются друг с другом.
tr.tr: Acı ve tatlı sulu iki denizi birbirine kavuşmamak üzere salıvermiştir.
tr.fr: Il a donné libre cours aux deux mers pour se rencontrer;
tr.id: Dia membiarkan dua lautan mengalir yang keduanya kemudian bertemu,
tr.ur: اسی نے دو دریا رواں کئے جو آپس میں ملتے ہیں
tr.bn: তিনি পাশাপাশি দুই দরিয়া প্রবাহিত করেছেন।
tr.de: Er hat den beiden Meeren freien Lauf gelassen; sie treffen aufeinander,

verses.ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

tr.en: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
tr.uz: Ўрталаридаги тўсиқдан ошиб ўтолмаслар. (Шўр денгиз билан чучук сувли дарё ўртасида бир тўсиқ бўлиб, улар бир-бирларига аралашиб кетмайди деган маънони англатади.)
tr.ru: Между ними существует преграда, которую они не могут преступить.
tr.tr: Aralarında bir engel vardır; birbirinin sınırını aşamazlar.
tr.fr: il y a entre elles une barrière qu'elles ne dépassent pas.
tr.id: antara keduanya ada batas yang tidak dilampaui masing-masing.
tr.ur: دونوں میں ایک آڑ ہے کہ (اس سے) تجاوز نہیں کرسکتے
tr.bn: উভয়ের মাঝখানে রয়েছে এক অন্তরাল, যা তারা অতিক্রম করে না।
tr.de: zwischen ihnen ist (aber) ein trennendes Hindernis, (das)s sie (ihre Grenzen) nicht überschreiten.

science: At the Strait of Gibraltar the Mediterranean (saltier, about 38 g of salt per kg) meets the Atlantic (about 36 g/kg). The denser Mediterranean water flows out along the bottom while lighter Atlantic water flows in at the surface. Density layers act as an invisible wall: the Mediterranean water keeps its own temperature and saltiness for thousands of kilometres, spreading in the Atlantic at 1,000–1,200 m depth.

Where rivers meet the sea the same thing happens: light fresh water rides over a wedge of salty water with a sharp boundary. Ocean scientists call these boundaries haloclines or pycnoclines, and mixing across them is slow.
Verse 25:53 mentions both kinds together: the “sweet and palatable” and the “salty and bitter”, kept apart by a barrier.

stats.label: Depth at which Mediterranean water spreads in the Atlantic

proof.title: Marsigli: two currents at once
proof.text: Luigi Marsigli explains a puzzle at the Bosphorus, where fresher water flows one way at the surface and saltier water the other way below. He demonstrates it with two liquids of different densities.

proof.title: Carpenter and Jeffreys at Gibraltar
proof.text: On HMS Porcupine, William Carpenter and Gwyn Jeffreys lower a drogue to 350 m at Gibraltar and find water flowing out of the Mediterranean against the surface current.

proof.title: The Meteor expedition
proof.text: The German research ship Meteor maps temperature and saltiness across the Atlantic and identifies a tongue of Mediterranean water spreading far out at depth.

proof.title: Seen from the ISS
proof.text: Astronauts photograph internal waves at Gibraltar, on the boundary where the two waters meet.

media.caption: Internal waves at the Strait of Gibraltar (ISS).
media.credit: Earth Observations Laboratory, Johnson Space Center. Arrows added…

fits: Two seas “meeting” with a barrier between them (barzakh) matches two water bodies meeting at Gibraltar with a density boundary.
25:53 speaks of fresh water and salt water kept apart, matching river mouths and salt wedges.
gaps: The waters do mix slowly; the “barrier” is a gradient, not a wall.
Many classical commentators took the two seas to be the fresh and the salt, or this world and the next.
The viral “two oceans that don't mix” photos (Gulf of Alaska) show glacier silt and are not evidence.

media.credit: Jeff Schmaltz, MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC

media.caption: Internal waves at the Strait of Gibraltar, on the boundary between the two waters.
media.credit: Earth Observations Laboratory, Johnson Space Center. Arrows added…

media.caption: Gibraltar from space (ESA astronaut Alexander Gerst).
NASA: how salty, dense water sinks and flows through the world's oceans.
media.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio…

facts.title: Darkness in the Deep Sea
facts.hook: Darkness in a deep sea, wave upon wave, and clouds above, a description of the ocean's layers.

verses.ar: أَوْ كَظُلُمَٰتٍۢ فِى بَحْرٍۢ لُّجِّىٍّۢ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ سَحَابٌۭ ۚ ظُلُمَٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورًۭا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ

tr.en: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allah has not granted light - for him there is no light.
tr.uz: Ёки худди қаърсиз денгиздаги зулматларга ўхшайдир. Унинг устидан мавж қоплагандир, у(мавж)нинг ҳам устидан мавж ва уни эса, булут (қоплагандир). Бир-бирининг устидаги зулматлардир. У қўлини чиқарса, кўра олмас. Кимгаки Аллоҳ нур бермаса, унинг учун нур бўлмас. (Ушбу ояти каримада ҳам Аллоҳнинг нуридан маҳрум бўлган кофир ва мунофиқларнинг ҳолати ажойиб услуб ила васф қилинмоқда. Яъни, денгизни катта тўлқин қоплаб олгандир. Бу тўлқин эса, зулмат устига зулматдир. Аммо бу ҳали ҳаммаси эмас. Ўша қоп-қора тўлқиннинг устидан қоп-қора булут қоплаб турибди. Бу зулматлар остида кофир ва мунофиқ қандай қилиб Аллоҳнинг нурини кўрсин. У ўз қўлини кўра олмагандан кейин, Аллоҳнинг нурини кўра олмаслиги турган гап.)
tr.ru: Или же они подобны мраку в глубине морской пучины. Его покрывает волна, над которой находится другая волна, над которой находится облако. Один мрак поверх другого! Если он вытянет свою руку, то не увидит ее. Кому Аллах не даровал света, тому не будет света.
tr.tr: Veya derin denizin karanlıklarına benzer. Onu üstüste dalgalar ve dalgaların üstünde de bulutlar örter; karanlıklar üstünde karanlıklar; insan elini uzattığı zaman, nerdeyse onu bile göremez. Allah'ın nur vermediği kimsenin nuru olmaz.
tr.fr: [Les actions des mécréants] sont encore semblables à des ténèbres sur une mer profonde: des vagues la recouvrent, [vagues] au dessus desquelles s'élèvent [d'autres] vagues, sur lesquelles il y a [d'épais] nuages. Ténèbres [entassées] les unes au-dessus des autres. Quand quelqu'un étend la main, il ne la distingue presque pas. Celui qu'Allah prive de lumière n'a aucune lumière.
tr.id: Atau seperti gelap gulita di lautan yang dalam, yang diliputi oleh ombak, yang di atasnya ombak (pula), di atasnya (lagi) awan; gelap gulita yang tindih-bertindih, apabila dia mengeluarkan tangannya, tiadalah dia dapat melihatnya, (dan) barangsiapa yang tiada diberi cahaya (petunjuk) oleh Allah tiadalah dia mempunyai cahaya sedikitpun.
tr.ur: یا (ان کے اعمال کی مثال ایسی ہے) جیسے دریائے عمیق میں اندھیرے جس پر لہر چڑھی چلی آتی ہو اور اس کے اوپر اور لہر (آرہی ہو) اور اس کے اوپر بادل ہو، غرض اندھیرے ہی اندھیرے ہوں، ایک پر ایک (چھایا ہوا) جب اپنا ہاتھ نکالے تو کچھ نہ دیکھ سکے۔ اور جس کو خدا روشنی نہ دے اس کو (کہیں بھی) روشنی نہیں (مل سکتی)
tr.bn: অথবা (তাদের কর্ম) প্রমত্ত সমুদ্রের বুকে গভীর অন্ধকারের ন্যায়, যাকে উদ্বেলিত করে তরঙ্গের উপর তরঙ্গ, যার উপরে ঘন কালো মেঘ আছে। একের উপর এক অন্ধকার। যখন সে তার হাত বের করে, তখন তাকে একেবারেই দেখতে পায় না। আল্লাহ যাকে জ্যোতি দেন না, তার কোন জ্যোতিই নেই।
tr.de: Oder (sie sind) wie Finsternisse in einem abgrundtiefen Meer, das von Wogen überdeckt ist, über denen (nochmals) Wogen sind, über denen (wiederum) Wolken sind: Finsternisse, eine über der anderen. Wenn er seine Hand ausstreckt, kann er sie kaum sehen. Und wem Allah kein Licht schafft, für den gibt es kein Licht.

science: Sunlight fades fast underwater. Red light vanishes within about 10 m, almost no light remains below 200 m, and below 1,000 m the ocean is in permanent darkness, except for the light that animals make themselves.

The phrase “wave upon wave” has a second meaning that oceanographers discovered later. As well as surface waves, the ocean has internal waves: enormous waves that travel along the boundaries between density layers beneath the surface, invisible from above. They can reach 100 m in height. Fridtjof Nansen's ship met their drag (“dead water”) in 1893, and Vagn Ekman explained it in 1904.
Humans saw the dark ocean directly only in 1934, when William Beebe and Otis Barton descended 923 m in the bathysphere.

stats.label: Depth below which almost no sunlight remains
Height of the largest internal waves

proof.title: Nansen: dead water
proof.text: Fridtjof Nansen's ship Fram is slowed almost to a halt in Arctic waters by “dead water”: a layer of fresh water lying over salt water.

media.caption: Nansen's ship Fram leaving Bergen, 1893.
media.credit: Appears in Fridtjof Nansen's 1893 book, so is PD in the US…

proof.title: Ekman: waves under the surface
proof.text: Vagn Walfrid Ekman shows that the ship makes waves below the surface, between the layers, that drag on it: internal waves.

proof.title: Beebe and Barton: 923 metres down
proof.text: Two men descend 923 m in a steel sphere. William Beebe reports that sunlight fades to black.

proof.title: Internal waves from space
proof.text: Satellites photograph the surface signature of internal waves, and ISS crews photograph them too.

media.caption: Internal waves seen from space in the Lombok Strait (NASA).
media.credit: Jeff Schmaltz, MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC

fits: Darkness deepens with depth, with waves above waves and clouds above: a layered scene.
“Wave over wave” matches an ocean with surface waves above internal waves.
A hand held out can hardly be seen, matching the darkness of the deep ocean.
gaps: Classical commentators pictured a stormy sea at night, which the words also fit.
Internal waves cannot be seen from a ship; that reading is modern.
It is a simile (“like darknesses”), not a scientific description.

media.caption: Ocean light zones: sunlit, twilight and midnight.
Internal waves visible from space in the Lombok Strait (NASA MODIS).
media.credit: Jeff Schmaltz, MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC

facts.title: The Fertilizing Winds
facts.hook: “We sent the fertilizing winds”: they carry pollen, and the seeds of rain.

verses.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ

tr.en: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
tr.uz: Биз шамолларни урчитувчилар этиб юбордик. Бас, осмондан сув тушириб, у ила сизларни сероб қилдик. Сизлар уни тўплаб олувчи эмассиз. (Яъни, Биз шамолларни ўлчов билан булутларни урчитувчи, бир-бирига қўшиб сув ҳосил қилувчи этиб юбордик. Асосан, ёмғирнинг ёғишига шамоллар сабаб бўлади. Улар маълум қоидаларга кўра эсади. Пайдо бўлган булутларнинг бир-бирлари ила қўшилишларидан сув ҳосил бўлади. Ана шундан кейин осмондан сув тушади, ёмғир ёғади. Аллоҳ таоло у сув билан ер юзини, одамларни сероб қилади. Деярли ҳамма ризқ осмондан тушган шу сувга боғлиқ бўлади. Инсон эса, Аллоҳ тайёр ҳолда унга осмондан тушириб берган сувни тўплаб олишга ҳам қодир эмас. Уни тўплашни ҳам булоқ, қудуқ, анҳор, ер ости кўллари ва бошқа воситалар орқали Аллоҳ таолонинг Ўзи амалга оширади.)
tr.ru: Мы послали ветры, оплодотворяющие облака водой, а потом низвели с неба воду и напоили вас ею, но не вам ее сберегать.
tr.tr: Rüzgarları aşılayıcı olarak gönderdik; yukarıdan su indirdik de sizi onunla suladık. Yoksa siz onu toplayamazdınız.
tr.fr: Et Nous envoyons les vents fécondants; et Nous faisons alors descendre du ciel une eau dont Nous vous abreuvons et que vous n'êtes pas en mesure de conserver.
tr.id: Dan Kami telah meniupkan angin untuk mengawinkan (tumbuh-tumbuhan) dan Kami turunkan hujan dari langit, lalu Kami beri minum kamu dengan air itu, dan sekali-kali bukanlah kamu yang menyimpannya.
tr.ur: اور ہم ہی ہوائیں چلاتے ہیں (جو بادلوں کے پانی سے) بھری ہوئی ہوتی ہیں اور ہم ہی آسمان سے مینہ برساتے ہیں اور ہم ہی تم کو اس کا پانی پلاتے ہیں اور تم تو اس کا خرانہ نہیں رکھتے
tr.bn: আমি বৃষ্টিগর্ভ বায়ু পরিচালনা করি অতঃপর আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করি, এরপর তোমাদেরকে তা পান করাই। বস্তুতঃ তোমাদের কাছে এর ভান্ডার নেই।
tr.de: Und Wir senden die Winde zur Befruchtung. Und Wir lassen dann vom Himmel Wasser hinabkommen und geben es euch zu trinken, doch ihr könnt es nicht (alles davon) als Vorrat lagern.

science: Wind is nature's courier. Wheat, maize, rice, grasses and most conifers rely on wind to carry pollen from male to female flowers.
Winds also “fertilize” clouds. They lift sea salt and dust into the air, and these tiny particles act as nuclei around which cloud droplets condense. No nuclei, no rain.
The verse goes on to link the two: after the winds, “We sent down water from the sky and gave it to you to drink.”

stats.label: Camerarius proves plant sex (wind pollination follows)

proof.title: Camerarius: plants have sexes
proof.text: Rudolf Camerarius shows that plants need pollen to make seeds.

proof.title: Kölreuter: pollen must travel
proof.text: Josef Kölreuter shows that pollen must reach the stigma, carried by insects or wind, for seeds to form.

media.caption: A pine releasing pollen into the wind.

proof.title: Aitken: raindrops need dust
proof.text: John Aitken shows that cloud droplets need tiny particles to form on; in perfectly clean air, mist does not appear.

fits: Lawāqiḥ (fertilizing) fits wind carrying pollen to fertilize plants.
It also fits winds that “impregnate” clouds, as many classical commentators read it.
The verse connects wind and rain in one sentence.
gaps: Wind is only one way plants are pollinated; insects carry much of the pollen.
The classical reading was about clouds; the pollen reading is one modern commentators add.
The verse names neither pollen nor condensation nuclei.

media.caption: A pine tree releasing a cloud of pollen into the wind.
A cloud of tree pollen drifting on the wind.

facts.title: Life From Water
facts.hook: “We made from water every living thing.”

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.en: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
tr.uz: Куфр келтирганлар осмонлару ер битишган бўлган эканини, бас, Биз уларни очганимизни ва сувдан ҳар бир тирик нарсани қилганимизни билмайдиларми? Иймон келтирмайдиларми? (Ояти карима маъноси хусусида тафсирчилар бир неча хил маънолар айтганлар. Биринчиси, Ибн Умар ва Ибн Аббослардан (р. а.) ривоят қилинган бўлиб, осмон ёпиқ эди, Биз уни очдик ва ёмғир-қор ёғдирдик, оқибатда ўша сув ила ҳамма тирик нарсалар пайдо бўлди, деган маъно чиқади. Иккинчиси, унга кўра осмонлару ер йўқ эди, уларни Биз яратдик, сўнгра сувдан тирик нарсаларни пайдо қилдик, маъноси бўлади. Учинчиси, Ҳасан, Қатодалардан (р. а.) ривоят қилинган бўлиб, осмонлару ер бир-бирига битишган бир нарса эди, уларнинг орасини Биз очдик, сўнгра сувдан тирик нарсаларни пайдо қилдик, маъноси бор. Тўртинчиси ҳозирги замон баъзи тафсирчиларнинг фикрлари бўлиб: осмону ер, юлдузлару қуёш ҳамма-ҳаммаси бир бутун эди, Аллоҳнинг иродаси ила кўп айланиш ва ички портлашлар оқибатида парчаланиб, алоҳида-алоҳида бўлиб кетди: қуёш алоҳида, ер алоҳида, ой алоҳида, юлдузлар алоҳида ва бошқа нарсалар ҳам; сувдан эса, барча тирик нарсалар, инсон, ҳайвон ва набототлар пайдо қилинди. Булар, ояти кариманинг маъносини тушунишга уринишдир. Оятнинг ҳақиқий маъносини Аллоҳнинг Ўзи билади.)
tr.ru: Неужели неверующие не видят, что небеса и земля были единым целым и что Мы разделили их и сотворили все живое из воды? Неужели они не уверуют?
tr.tr: İnkar edenler, gökler ve yer yapışıkken onları ayırdığımızı ve bütün canlıları sudan meydana getirdiğimizi bilmezler mi? İnanmıyorlar mı?
tr.fr: Ceux qui ont mécru, n'ont-ils pas vu que les cieux et la terre formaient une masse compacte? Ensuite Nous les avons séparés et fait de l'eau toute chose vivante. Ne croiront-ils donc pas?
tr.id: Dan apakah orang-orang yang kafir tidak mengetahui bahwasanya langit dan bumi itu keduanya dahulu adalah suatu yang padu, kemudian Kami pisahkan antara keduanya. Dan dari air Kami jadikan segala sesuatu yang hidup. Maka mengapakah mereka tiada juga beriman?
tr.ur: کیا کافروں نے نہیں دیکھا کہ آسمان اور زمین دونوں ملے ہوئے تھے تو ہم نے جدا جدا کردیا۔ اور تمام جاندار چیزیں ہم نے پانی سے بنائیں۔ پھر یہ لوگ ایمان کیوں نہیں لاتے؟
tr.bn: কাফেররা কি ভেবে দেখে না যে, আকাশমন্ডলী ও পৃথিবীর মুখ বন্ধ ছিল, অতঃপর আমি উভয়কে খুলে দিলাম এবং প্রাণবন্ত সবকিছু আমি পানি থেকে সৃষ্টি করলাম। এরপরও কি তারা বিশ্বাস স্থাপন করবে না?
tr.de: Sehen denn diejenigen, die ungläubig sind, nicht, daß die Himmel und die Erde eine zusammenhängende Masse waren? Da haben Wir sie getrennt und aus dem Wasser alles Lebendige gemacht. Wollen sie denn nicht glauben?

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

tr.en: Allah has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
tr.uz: Аллоҳ ҳамма жониворни сувдан яратди. Бас, улардан баъзилари қорни билан юрадир, баъзилари икки оёқ билан юрадир ва баъзилари тўрт (оёқ) билан. Аллоҳ Ўзи хоҳлаган нарсани яратур. Албатта, Аллоҳ ҳар бир нарсага қодирдир.
tr.ru: Аллах сотворил все живые существа из воды. Среди них есть такие, которые ползают на брюхе, такие, которые ходят на двух ногах, и такие, которые ходят на четырех. Аллах творит то, что пожелает. Воистину, Аллах способен на всякую вещь.
tr.tr: Allah bütün canlıları sudan yaratmıştır. Kimi karnı üzerinde sürünür, kimi iki ayakla yürür, kimi dört ayakla yürür. Allah dilediğini yaratır, Allah şüphesiz herşeye Kadir'dir.
tr.fr: Et Allah a créé d'eau tout animal. Il y en a qui marche sur le ventre, d'autres marchent sur deux pattes, et d'autres encore marchent sur quatre. Allah crée ce qu'Il veut et Allah est Omnipotent.
tr.id: Dan Allah telah menciptakan semua jenis hewan dari air, maka sebagian dari hewan itu ada yang berjalan di atas perutnya dan sebagian berjalan dengan dua kaki sedang sebagian (yang lain) berjalan dengan empat kaki. Allah menciptakan apa yang dikehendaki-Nya, sesungguhnya Allah Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu.
tr.ur: اور خدا ہی نے ہر چلنے پھرنے والے جاندار کو پانی سے پیدا کیا۔ تو اس میں بعضے ایسے ہیں کہ پیٹ کے بل چلتے ہیں اور بعض ایسے ہیں جو دو پاؤں پر چلتے ہیں اور بعض ایسے ہیں جو چار پاؤں پر چلتے ہیں۔ خدا جو چاہتا ہے پیدا کرتا ہے، بےشک خدا ہر چیز پر قادر ہے
tr.bn: আল্লাহ প্রত্যেক চলন্ত জীবকে পানি দ্বারা সৃষ্টি করেছেন। তাদের কতক বুকে ভয় দিয়ে চলে, কতক দুই পায়ে ভর দিয়ে চলে এবং কতক চার পায়ে ভর দিয়ে চলে; আল্লাহ যা ইচ্ছা সৃষ্টি করেন। নিশ্চয়ই আল্লাহ সবকিছু করতে সক্ষম।
tr.de: Und Allah hat jedes Tier aus Wasser erschaffen. So gibt es unter ihnen solche, die auf ihrem Bauch kriechen, und solche, die auf zwei Beinen gehen, und (wieder) solche, die auf Vieren gehen. Allah erschafft, was Er will. Gewiß, Allah hat zu allem die Macht.

science: Every living thing on Earth depends on liquid water. Water is roughly 60% of an adult human's body weight and about 70% of a cell's contents. Some jellyfish are 95% water.

Life itself probably began in water. The earliest traces of life, in rocks 3.5 billion years old, formed in ancient seas or hot springs. In the 1920s Alexander Oparin and J. B. S. Haldane independently proposed that life arose in a watery “primordial soup”.
It is why space agencies “follow the water” in the search for life on Mars and on Jupiter's moon Europa.

stats.label: Water in an adult human body
Age of the oldest traces of life

proof.title: Leeuwenhoek: life in a drop
proof.text: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek sees living “animalcules” in a drop of lake water through his microscope: life teeming in water.

media.caption: A Leeuwenhoek microscope.

proof.title: Oparin and Haldane: life began in water
proof.text: Alexander Oparin and J. B. S. Haldane independently propose that life arose in a warm, watery “primordial soup”.

proof.title: Miller and Urey: building blocks from water
proof.text: Stanley Miller passes sparks through water and gases thought to have been on the early Earth and makes amino acids, the building blocks of proteins.

media.caption: The Miller–Urey experiment.

proof.title: Alvin: life around deep-sea vents
proof.text: The submersible Alvin finds thriving communities around hot vents on the deep sea floor, living without sunlight but not without water.

media.caption: Giant tube worms at a hydrothermal vent (Ifremer).

proof.title: The oldest fossils
proof.text: Stromatolites in Western Australia, about 3.48 billion years old, are among the oldest known signs of life.

media.caption: A 3.48-billion-year-old stromatolite from Western Australia.

fits: Every known organism depends on liquid water: cells are mostly water and biochemistry happens in it.
Life very probably began in water and lived there for billions of years before reaching land.
gaps: “Water” may also mean rain giving life to the earth, and scholars read it in several ways.
“Every living thing” is broad; some organisms survive dry for years in dormant form.
The verse says nothing about how life began.

facts.title: The Bee Is Addressed as Female
facts.hook: The Quran commands the bee in the feminine, and every foraging honeybee is female.

verses.ar: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ

tr.en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
tr.uz: Роббинг асаларига: «Тоғлардан, дарахтлардан ва кўтарилган сўритоклардан уй тутгин.
tr.ru: Твой Господь внушил пчеле: «Воздвигай жилища в горах, на деревьях и в строениях.
tr.tr: Rabbin bal arısına: "Dağlarda, ağaçlarda ve hazırlanmış kovanlarda yuva edin; sonra her çeşit üründen ye; sonra da Rabbinin işlemen için gösterdiği yollardan yürü" diye öğretti. Karınlarından insanlara şifa olan çeşitli renklerde bal çıkar. Düşünen bir millet için bunda ibret vardır.
tr.fr: [Et voilà] ce que ton Seigneur révéla aux abeilles: «Prenez des demeures dans les montagnes, les arbres, et les treillages que [les hommes] font.
tr.id: Dan Tuhanmu mewahyukan kepada lebah: "Buatlah sarang-sarang di bukit-bukit, di pohon-pohon kayu, dan di tempat-tempat yang dibikin manusia",
tr.ur: اور تمہارے پروردگار نے شہد کی مکھیوں کو ارشاد فرمایا کہ پہاڑوں میں اور درختوں میں اور اونچی اونچی چھتریوں میں جو لوگ بناتے ہیں گھر بنا
tr.bn: আপনার পালনকর্তা মধু মক্ষিকাকে আদেশ দিলেনঃ পর্বতগাহ্রে, বৃক্ষ এবং উঁচু চালে গৃহ তৈরী কর,
tr.de: Und dein Herr hat der Biene eingegeben: "Nimm dir in den Bergen Häuser, in den Bäumen und in dem, was sie an Spalieren errichten.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًۭا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

tr.en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
tr.uz: Сўнгра ҳамма мевалардан егин. Бас, Роббинг осон қилиб қўйган йўллардан юргин», деб ваҳий қилди. Уларнинг қоринларидан турли рангдаги шароб чиқар. Унда одамлар учун шифо бордир. Албатта, бунда тафаккур қилувчилар учун оят-белги бордир. (Аллоҳ таолонинг ҳайвонотларга, жумладан, асаларига ваҳий қилиши унга илҳом бериши ҳисобланади. ллоҳ таоло асаларини яратганда унга ҳис-туйғу ва илҳомни қўшиб яратгани учун у кўргина ақлли инсонлар ҳам қила олмайдигананиқлик билан ўзига топширилган ишни бажаради.)
tr.ru: А потом питайся всевозможными плодами и следуй по путям твоего Господа, которые доступны тебе». Из брюшков пчел исходит питье разных цветов, которое приносит людям исцеление. Воистину, в этом - знамение для людей размышляющих.
tr.tr: Rabbin bal arısına: "Dağlarda, ağaçlarda ve hazırlanmış kovanlarda yuva edin; sonra her çeşit üründen ye; sonra da Rabbinin işlemen için gösterdiği yollardan yürü" diye öğretti. Karınlarından insanlara şifa olan çeşitli renklerde bal çıkar. Düşünen bir millet için bunda ibret vardır.
tr.fr: Puis mangez de toute espèce de fruits, et suivez les sentiers de votre Seigneur, rendus faciles pour vous. De leur ventre, sort une liqueur, aux couleurs variées, dans laquelle il y a une guérison pour les gens. Il y a vraiment là une preuve pour des gens qui réfléchissent.
tr.id: kemudian makanlah dari tiap-tiap (macam) buah-buahan dan tempuhlah jalan Tuhanmu yang telah dimudahkan (bagimu). Dari perut lebah itu ke luar minuman (madu) yang bermacam-macam warnanya, di dalamnya terdapat obat yang menyembuhkan bagi manusia. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kebesaran Tuhan) bagi orang-orang yang memikirkan.
tr.ur: اور ہر قسم کے میوے کھا۔ اور اپنے پروردگار کے صاف رستوں پر چلی جا۔ اس کے پیٹ سے پینے کی چیز نکلتی ہے جس کے مختلف رنگ ہوتے ہیں اس میں لوگوں (کے کئی امراض) کی شفا ہے۔ بےشک سوچنے والوں کے لیے اس میں بھی نشانی ہے
tr.bn: এরপর সর্বপ্রকার ফল থেকে ভক্ষণ কর এবং আপন পালনকর্তার উম্মুক্ত পথ সমূহে চলমান হও। তার পেট থেকে বিভিন্ন রঙে পানীয় নির্গত হয়। তাতে মানুষের জন্যে রয়েছে রোগের প্রতিকার। নিশ্চয় এতে চিন্তাশীল সম্প্রদায়ের জন্যে নিদর্শন রয়েছে।
tr.de: Hierauf iß von allen Früchten, ziehe auf den Wegen deines Herrn dahin, die (dir) geebnet sind." Aus ihren Leibern kommt ein Getränk von unterschiedlichen Farben, in dem Heilung für die Menschen ist. Darin ist wahrlich ein Zeichen für Leute, die nachdenken.

science: In a hive, the workers that fly out to gather nectar are all female. Males (drones) do not forage; they exist to mate. Arabic marks gender in commands, and the verbs ittakhidhī (take up!), kulī (eat!) and fasluki (follow!) are all feminine forms.

For centuries Europeans spoke of a “king bee”. Jan Swammerdam's dissections in the 1660s revealed that the ruler of the hive was a queen with ovaries; the workers were later understood to be females too.

“A drink of varying colours, in which is healing”: honey ranges from near-white to almost black depending on the flowers. It is acidic (pH about 3.9), very low in water, and its enzymes make hydrogen peroxide, which is why medical-grade honey is used on wounds today.

stats.label: Swammerdam shows the “king” is a queen

proof.title: Butler: the “king” is a queen
proof.text: The English beekeeper Charles Butler argues in The Feminine Monarchie that the hive's ruler is a queen.

proof.title: Swammerdam: the proof by dissection
proof.text: Jan Swammerdam dissects the “king” bee and finds ovaries. The ruler of the hive is female.

media.caption: An early engraving of the reproductive organs of the bee (Wellcome Collection).

proof.title: Huber: the workers
proof.text: The blind Swiss naturalist François Huber and his assistant show that the queen mates in flight and that the workers are undeveloped females.

proof.title: Van Ketel: honey kills bacteria
proof.text: The Dutch scientist Bernardus van Ketel reports that honey has antibacterial properties.

proof.title: White: the enzyme
proof.text: Jonathan White finds the enzyme in honey that slowly produces hydrogen peroxide, one reason honey fights germs.

proof.title: Honey dressings approved
proof.text: The US FDA clears the first medical-grade honey dressings for wounds.

fits: The commands to the bee (ittakhidhī, kulī, fasluki) are all in the feminine, and forager bees are all female.
“Houses in the mountains and the trees” matches wild hives in cliffs and hollow trees.
“A drink of varying colours in which is healing” matches honey's range of colours and its medical use.
gaps: Naḥl (bees) is a grammatically feminine collective in Arabic, so the feminine form alone does not prove the workers' sex.
The verse does not say honey cures everything; the evidence supports specific uses.
The bee's “inspiration” (waḥy) is not something science addresses.

media.caption: A worker honeybee (female) collecting pollen.
A wild honeycomb built in a tree: “houses in the trees”.
A honeybee at work.

facts.title: Milk, Between Digestion and Blood
facts.hook: Pure milk comes from “between excretion and blood”: nutrients pass from the gut into the blood, and from the blood into milk.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍۢ وَدَمٍۢ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًۭا سَآئِغًۭا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

tr.en: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
tr.uz: Чорва ҳайвонларида ҳам сиз учун, албатта, ибрат бордир. Биз сизларни уларнинг қорнидан, гўнг ва қон орасидан ичувчилар (томоғи)дан осон ўтувчи соф сут ила суғорамиз.
tr.ru: Воистину, в домашней скотине для вас - назидание. Мы поим вас тем, что образуется в их животах между пометом и кровью, - чистым молоком, приятным для пьющих.
tr.tr: Hayvanlarda da size ibretler vardır. Bağırsaklarındakiler ile kan arasından, içenlere halis ve içimi kolay süt içiririz.
tr.fr: Il y a certes un enseignement pour vous dans les bestiaux: Nous vous abreuvons de ce qui est dans leurs ventres, - [un produit] extrait du [mélange] des excréments [intestinaux] et du sang - un lait pur, délicieux pour les buveurs.
tr.id: Dan sesungguhnya pada binatang ternak itu benar-benar terdapat pelajaran bagi kamu. Kami memberimu minum dari pada apa yang berada dalam perutnya (berupa) susu yang bersih antara tahi dan darah, yang mudah ditelan bagi orang-orang yang meminumnya.
tr.ur: اور تمہارے لیے چارپایوں میں بھی (مقام) عبرت (وغور) ہے کہ ان کے پیٹوں میں جو گوبر اور لہو ہے اس سے ہم تم کو خالص دودھ پلاتے ہیں جو پینے والوں کے لیے خوشگوار ہے
tr.bn: তোমাদের জন্যে চতুস্পদ জন্তুদের মধ্যে চিন্তা করার অবকাশ রয়েছে। আমি তোমাদেরকে পান করাই তাদের উদরস্থিত বস্তুসমুহের মধ্যে থেকে গোবর ও রক্ত নিঃসৃত দুগ্ধ যা পানকারীদের জন্যে উপাদেয়।
tr.de: Gewiß, auch im Vieh habt ihr wahrlich eine Lehre. Wir geben euch von dem, was in ihren Leibern zwischen Kot und Blut ist, zu trinken, reine Milch, angenehm für diejenigen, die (sie) trinken.

science: Milk is made in the mammary gland from nutrients that the intestines absorb from digested food and the blood carries to the udder. The gland's cells draw amino acids, sugars and fats from the blood and turn them into milk. A cow must pump roughly 400–500 litres of blood through her udder to make one litre of milk.
So milk really does come from “between” the two: nutrients from the gut, then blood, then the gland.

stats.label: Blood pumped through a cow's udder for 1 L of milk

proof.title: Linzell: following the blood
proof.text: John Linzell measures blood flow through the mammary glands of lactating goats, and what the blood loses on the way through. Hundreds of times more blood passes through than the milk that is made.

media.caption: A dairy cow (USDA).

proof.title: Dairy science confirms it
proof.text: Sugars, amino acids and fats absorbed from the gut are carried by the blood to the udder, where the gland cells remove them and assemble milk.

fits: Nutrients absorbed from the gut go into the blood, and the mammary gland builds milk from the blood: “between” the two.
“Pure milk, pleasant to drink” contrasts the milk with what it comes from.
gaps: Farth means partly digested matter in the gut; the physiology reading is modern.
Milk is not made in the gut or directly between gut and blood; it is made in the gland from blood.
Older commentators read the verse as a lesson in God's provision, without physiology.

media.caption: A dairy cow (USDA).
Cows grazing: “in grazing livestock is a lesson for you”.
Milk under the microscope.

facts.title: Stages in the Womb
facts.hook: A drop, a clinging structure, a chewed-looking lump, bones clothed with flesh: the womb's stages in one verse.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ

tr.en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
tr.uz: Қасамки, батаҳқиқ, инсонни лой сулоласидан яратдик.
tr.ru: Воистину, Мы сотворили человека из эссенции глины.
tr.tr: And olsun ki, insanı süzme çamurdan yarattık.
tr.fr: Nous avons certes créé l'homme d'un extrait d'argile.
tr.id: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari suatu saripati (berasal) dari tanah.
tr.ur: اور ہم نے انسان کو مٹی کے خلاصے سے پیدا کیا ہے
tr.bn: আমি মানুষকে মাটির সারাংশ থেকে সৃষ্টি করেছি।
tr.de: Wir schufen den Menschen ja aus einem Auszug aus Lehm.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ

tr.en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
tr.uz: Сўнгра уни мустаҳкам қароргоҳда нутфа қилдик.
tr.ru: Потом Мы поместили его каплей в надежном месте.
tr.tr: Sonra onu nutfe halinde sağlam bir yere yerleştirdik.
tr.fr: puis Nous en fîmes une goutte de sperme dans un reposoir solide.
tr.id: Kemudian Kami jadikan saripati itu air mani (yang disimpan) dalam tempat yang kokoh (rahim).
tr.ur: پھر اس کو ایک مضبوط (اور محفوظ) جگہ میں نطفہ بنا کر رکھا
tr.bn: অতঃপর আমি তাকে শুক্রবিন্দু রূপে এক সংরক্ষিত আধারে স্থাপন করেছি।
tr.de: Hierauf machten Wir ihn zu einem Samentropfen in einem festen Aufenthaltsort.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ

tr.en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
tr.uz: Сўнгра нутфадан алақа яратдик, алақадан чайналган гўшт яратдик, чайналган парча гўштдан суяк яратдик, бас, суякка гўшт қопладик, сўнгра уни бошқа бир жонзот этиб пайдо қилдик. Бас, яратгувчиларнинг энг яхшиси Аллоҳ баракотли ва буюкдир.
tr.ru: Потом Мы создали из капли сгусток крови, потом создали из сгустка крови разжеванный кусочек, потом создали из этого кусочка кости, и потом облекли кости мясом. Потом Мы вырастили его в другом творении. Благословен же Аллах, Наилучший из творцов!
tr.tr: Sonra nutfeyi kan pıhtısına çevirdik, kan pıhtısını bir çiğnemlik et yaptık, bir çiğnemlik etten kemikler yarattık, kemiklere de et giydirdik. Sonra onu başka bir yaratık yaptık: Biçim verenlerin en güzeli olan Allah ne uludur!
tr.fr: Ensuite, Nous avons fait du sperme une adhérence; et de l'adhérence Nous avons créé un embryon; puis, de cet embryon Nous avons créé des os et Nous avons revêtu les os de chair. Ensuite, Nous l'avons transformé en une tout autre création. Gloire à Allah le Meilleur des créateurs!
tr.id: Kemudian air mani itu Kami jadikan segumpal darah, lalu segumpal darah itu Kami jadikan segumpal daging, dan segumpal daging itu Kami jadikan tulang belulang, lalu tulang belulang itu Kami bungkus dengan daging. Kemudian Kami jadikan dia makhluk yang (berbentuk) lain. Maka Maha sucilah Allah, Pencipta Yang Paling Baik.
tr.ur: پھر نطفے کا لوتھڑا بنایا۔ پھر لوتھڑے کی بوٹی بنائی پھر بوٹی کی ہڈیاں بنائیں پھر ہڈیوں پر گوشت (پوست) چڑھایا۔ پھر اس کو نئی صورت میں بنا دیا۔ تو خدا جو سب سے بہتر بنانے والا بڑا بابرکت ہے
tr.bn: এরপর আমি শুক্রবিন্দুকে জমাট রক্তরূপে সৃষ্টি করেছি, অতঃপর জমাট রক্তকে মাংসপিন্ডে পরিণত করেছি, এরপর সেই মাংসপিন্ড থেকে অস্থি সৃষ্টি করেছি, অতঃপর অস্থিকে মাংস দ্বারা আবৃত করেছি, অবশেষে তাকে নতুন রূপে দাঁড় করিয়েছি। নিপুণতম সৃষ্টিকর্তা আল্লাহ কত কল্যাণময়।
tr.de: Hierauf schufen Wir den Samentropfen zu einem Anhängsel, dann schufen Wir das Anhängsel zu einem kleinen Klumpen, dann schufen Wir den kleinen Klumpen zu Knochen, dann bekleideten Wir die Knochen mit Fleisch. Hierauf ließen Wir ihn als eine weitere Schöpfung entstehen. Segensreich ist Allah, der beste Schöpfer.

science: After fertilisation the egg divides into a ball of cells, the blastocyst, a tiny “drop” (nuṭfah). About 6 to 10 days later it settles in the “firm lodging” of the womb (23:13) and implants: it literally clings to the uterine wall (ʿalaqah, “that which clings”).

Between about days 20 and 30 after fertilisation, the embryo is a small curved body lined along its back with rounded blocks of tissue called somites. Many find the resemblance to a chewed morsel (muḍghah) striking.

Cartilage models of the bones form and begin to harden around weeks 6–8 after fertilisation while muscle grows around them. By eight weeks all the major organs are present and the embryo looks recognisably human, “another creation” (khalqan ākhar).

stats.label: Implantation: the embryo “clings” to the womb
Somites form along the embryo's back

proof.title: Harvey: watching development
proof.text: William Harvey opens hens' eggs at intervals, and studies deer embryos, and describes development stage by stage: omne vivum ex ovo, every animal from an egg.

media.caption: The frontispiece of Harvey's book: everything from an egg.

proof.title: Malpighi: the chick under the microscope
proof.text: Marcello Malpighi watches the chick embryo through a microscope, seeing the heart beat and the body form.

proof.title: Von Baer: the mammalian egg
proof.text: Karl Ernst von Baer discovers the egg cell of mammals in a dog's ovary.

proof.title: Hertwig: fertilisation seen
proof.text: Oscar Hertwig watches a sperm enter a sea-urchin egg and the two nuclei fuse.

proof.title: The Carnegie stages
proof.text: George Streeter and later Ronan O'Rahilly sort a museum collection of human embryos into 23 stages, giving the standard timetable of development.

media.caption: A page from the Carnegie Institution's Contributions to Embryology.

proof.title: IVF: watching the first days
proof.text: The first IVF baby lets doctors watch human embryos from fertilisation to implantation for the first time.

media.caption: A human embryo at about 8 weeks (museum specimen).

fits: The order drop → clinging thing → chewed-like lump → bones → flesh → “another creation” matches the order blastocyst implants, embryo with somites, skeleton and muscle, recognisably human form.
The words are visual and concrete, matching stages a physician could see.
gaps: Cartilage and muscle form together, so “bones then flesh” is not a clean sequence.
Galen and Aristotle already described stages of the embryo, so the words may describe what earlier physicians knew.
ʿAlaqah has been read as “blood clot”, “leech-like” or “clinging thing”; the last is the modern reading.
The resemblance of somites to a chewed morsel depends on the model used.

media.caption: A human embryo at about 8 weeks (museum specimen).
Diagram of early embryonic development.
A human embryo at the implantation stage, showing the yolk sac.

facts.title: Male or Female from a Drop
facts.hook: Male or female is decided by the sperm-drop, a fact biology confirmed in 1905.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ

tr.en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
tr.uz: Албатта, икки жуфтни; эркак ва аёлни яратган ҳам Ўзи.
tr.ru: Он сотворил пару - мужчину и женщину (или самца и самку) -
tr.tr: Doğrusu, atıldığında meniden erkek ve dişiyi, iki çifti yaratan O'dur.
tr.fr: et que c'est Lui qui a crée les deux éléments de couple, le mâle et la femelle,
tr.id: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menciptakan berpasang-pasangan pria dan wanita.
tr.ur: اور یہ کہ وہی نر اور مادہ دو قسم (کے حیوان) پیدا کرتا ہے
tr.bn: এবং তিনিই সৃষ্টি করেন যুগল-পুরুষ ও নারী।
tr.de: daß Er beide Teile des Paares, das Männliche und das Weibliche, erschafft

verses.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

tr.en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
tr.uz: Нутфадан, оқиб тушганда.
tr.ru: из капли, которая извергается.
tr.tr: Doğrusu, atıldığında meniden erkek ve dişiyi, iki çifti yaratan O'dur.
tr.fr: d'une goutte de sperme quand elle est éjaculée
tr.id: dari air mani, apabila dipancarkan.
tr.ur: (یعنی) نطفے سے جو (رحم میں) ڈالا جاتا ہے
tr.bn: একবিন্দু বীর্য থেকে যখন স্খলিত করা হয়।
tr.de: aus einem Samentropfen, wenn er ausgespritzt wird,

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ

tr.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
tr.uz: У манийдан оққан нутфа бўлмаганмиди?
tr.ru: Разве он не был каплей из семени источаемого?
tr.tr: O, katılan bir meni damlası değil miydi?
tr.fr: N'était-il pas une goutte de sperme éjaculé?
tr.id: Bukankah dia dahulu setetes mani yang ditumpahkan (ke dalam rahim),
tr.ur: کیا وہ منی کا جو رحم میں ڈالی جاتی ہے ایک قطرہ نہ تھا؟
tr.bn: সে কি স্খলিত বীর্য ছিল না?
tr.de: Ist er nicht ein Tropfen von Samenflüssigkeit, die ausgespritzt wird,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

tr.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
tr.uz: Сўнг алақа бўлди. Бас бекаму-кўст этиб яратди.
tr.ru: Потом он превратился в сгусток крови, после чего Он создал его и придал ему соразмерный облик.
tr.tr: Sonra kan pıhtısı olmuş, sonra Allah onu yaratıp şekil vermişti.
tr.fr: Et ensuite une adhérence Puis [Allah] l'a créée et formée harmonieusement;
tr.id: kemudian mani itu menjadi segumpal darah, lalu Allah menciptakannya, dan menyempurnakannya,
tr.ur: پھر لوتھڑا ہوا پھر (خدا نے) اس کو بنایا پھر (اس کے اعضا کو) درست کیا
tr.bn: অতঃপর সে ছিল রক্তপিন্ড, অতঃপর আল্লাহ তাকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন এবং সুবিন্যস্ত করেছেন।
tr.de: hierauf ein Anhängsel gewesen? Da hat Er erschaffen und zurechtgeformt

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

tr.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
tr.uz: Бас ундан жуфтни–эркак ва аёлни яратди.
tr.ru: Он сотворил из него чету: мужчину и женщину.
tr.tr: Ondan, erkek, dişi iki cins yaratmıştı.
tr.fr: puis en a fait alors les deux éléments de couple: le mâle et la femelle?
tr.id: lalu Allah menjadikan daripadanya sepasang: laki-laki dan perempuan.
tr.ur: پھر اس کی دو قسمیں بنائیں (ایک) مرد اور (ایک) عورت
tr.bn: অতঃপর তা থেকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন যুগল নর ও নারী।
tr.de: und dann daraus beide Teile des Paares gemacht, das Männliche und das Weibliche.

science: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes. Every egg carries an X. A sperm carries either an X (a girl) or a Y (a boy). So the sex of a child is determined by the father's sperm.
Nettie Stevens and Edmund Wilson identified the sex chromosomes in 1905. The SRY gene on the Y chromosome that switches on male development was found in 1990.
In many societies mothers have been blamed for having daughters. The verse assigns the determining role to the drop, “when it is emitted”.

proof.title: The X chromosome appears
proof.text: Hermann Henking sees a strange chromosome in insects; in 1902 Clarence McClung suggests it may decide sex.

proof.title: Stevens and Wilson: sex chromosomes
proof.text: Nettie Stevens, studying mealworms, and Edmund Wilson, studying bugs, each show that males and females differ by one chromosome, and that sex depends on which sperm meets the egg.

media.caption: Nettie Stevens.
media.credit: Carnegie Institution of Washington (according to the back of the…

proof.title: XXY and XO: the Y decides
proof.text: People with XXY chromosomes are male (Klinefelter syndrome), and those with a single X are female (Turner syndrome): it is the Y that makes the difference.

proof.title: SRY: the switch
proof.text: Peter Goodfellow's team finds the SRY gene on the Y chromosome; in 1991 Koopman's team shows that adding it to female mice makes them male.

media.caption: The human chromosomes; the sex chromosomes are the last pair.

fits: The verse says both sexes come “from a sperm-drop when it is emitted”, and the sperm's X or Y sets the sex.
75:37–39 repeats it: an emitted drop, a clinging thing, then male and female.
gaps: Nuṭfah can mean the mixed fluid, not specifically the chromosomes.
Classical commentators read the verse as God's power over creation, not chromosome biology.
The egg supplies half the chromosomes; the sperm does not create the child alone.

media.caption: The 23 human chromosome pairs; the last pair (X and Y) decides sex.
A male karyotype with its X and Y chromosomes (NHGRI).
media.credit: Courtesy: National Human Genome Research Institute

facts.title: Hearing, Then Sight
facts.hook: The Quran lists hearing before sight, the order in which the senses awaken before birth.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

tr.en: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
tr.uz: Сўнгра уни ростлади ва унинг ичига Ўз руҳидан пуфлади. У сизларга қулоқ, кўзлар ва диллар пайдо қилди. Камдан-кам шукр қилурсизлар.
tr.ru: затем придал ему соразмерный облик, вдохнул в него от Своего духа и даровал вам слух, зрение и сердца. Но как мала ваша благодарность!
tr.tr: Yarattığı her şeyi güzel yaratan, insanı başlangıçta çamurdan yaratan, sonra onun soyunu, bayağı bir suyun özünden yapan, sonra onu şekillendirip ruhundan ona üfleyen Allah'tır. Size kulaklar, gözler, kalbler verilmiştir. Öyleyken, pek az şükrediyorsunuz.
tr.fr: puis Il lui donna sa forme parfaite et lui insuffla de Son Esprit. Et Il vous a assigné l'ouïe, les yeux et le cœur. Que vous êtes peu reconnaissants!
tr.id: Kemudian Dia menyempurnakan dan meniupkan ke dalamnya roh (ciptaan)-Nya dan Dia menjadikan bagi kamu pendengaran, penglihatan dan hati; (tetapi) kamu sedikit sekali bersyukur.
tr.ur: پھر اُس کو درست کیا پھر اس میں اپنی (طرف سے) روح پھونکی اور تمہارے کان اور آنکھیں اور دل بنائے مگر تم بہت کم شکر کرتے ہو
tr.bn: অতঃপর তিনি তাকে সুষম করেন, তাতে রূহ সঞ্চার করেন এবং তোমাদেরকে দেন কর্ণ, চক্ষু ও অন্তঃকরণ। তোমরা সামান্যই কৃতজ্ঞতা প্রকাশ কর।
tr.de: Hierauf formte Er ihn zurecht und hauchte ihm von Seinem Geist ein, und Er hat euch Gehör, Augenlicht und Herzen gemacht. Wie wenig ihr dankbar seid!

verses.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

tr.en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
tr.uz: Албатта, Биз инсонни аралаш нутфадан яратдик. Синаш учун, бас, уни эшитадиган, кўрадиган қилдик.
tr.ru: Мы создали человека из смешанной капли, подвергая его испытанию, и сделали его слышащим и зрячим.
tr.tr: Biz insanı katışık bir nutfeden yaratmışızdır; onu deneriz; bu yüzden, onun işitmesini ve görmesini sağlamışızdır.
tr.fr: En effet, Nous avons créé l'homme d'une goutte de sperme mélangé [aux composantes diverses] pour le mettre à l'épreuve. [C'est pourquoi] Nous l'avons fait entendant et voyant.
tr.id: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari setetes mani yang bercampur yang Kami hendak mengujinya (dengan perintah dan larangan), karena itu Kami jadikan dia mendengar dan melihat.
tr.ur: ہم نے انسان کو نطفہٴ مخلوط سے پیدا کیا تاکہ اسے آزمائیں تو ہم نے اس کو سنتا دیکھتا بنایا
tr.bn: আমি মানুষকে সৃষ্টি করেছি মিশ্র শুক্রবিন্দু থেকে, এভাবে যে, তাকে পরীক্ষা করব অতঃপর তাকে করে দিয়েছি শ্রবণ ও দৃষ্টিশক্তিসম্পন্ন।
tr.de: Wir haben den Menschen ja aus einem Samentropfen, einem Gemisch erschaffen, (um) ihn zu prüfen. Und so haben Wir ihn mit Gehör und Augenlicht versehen.

science: The inner ear is working by about 18–20 weeks of pregnancy, and the fetus first responds to sound around week 19 (Hepper & Shahidullah, 1994). The eyelids fuse shut at about 10 weeks and reopen only around 26 weeks.
After birth, newborns already recognise their mother's voice (DeCasper & Fifer, 1980): the sound they heard in the womb.
The Quran lists “hearing” before “sight” in almost every place the two occur, and in 32:9 adds “hearts”, the seat of understanding, third.

proof.title: DeCasper and Fifer: newborns know the voice
proof.text: Newborns suck faster to hear their mother's voice than another woman's: they learned it in the womb.

proof.title: Hepper and Shahidullah: sound at 19 weeks
proof.text: Ultrasound shows fetuses moving in response to sound from 19 weeks of pregnancy.

proof.title: The eyes open later
proof.text: The eyelids fuse shut around week 10 and reopen around week 26, and the retina responds to light later still.

fits: Hearing is listed before sight in 32:9, 76:2 and other verses.
Fetal hearing works weeks before the eyes open.
gaps: The Arabic wa (“and”) does not set an order.
Hearing before sight may simply be the usual order in which the Quran lists them.
“Hearts”, listed third in 32:9, are the first organ to work in the embryo, so the list is not a developmental timeline.

media.caption: A human embryo at about 8 weeks, before the senses have begun to work.

sources.title: Newborns prefer their mothers' voices (DeCasper & Fifer, 1980)

facts.title: The Fingertips
facts.hook: God is able to reassemble the bones, “down to the very tips of the fingers.”

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ

tr.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
tr.uz: (Кофир) Инсон Бизни, унинг суякларини жамлай олмас, деб ўйларми?
tr.ru: Неужели человек полагает, что Мы не соберем его костей?
tr.tr: İnsan, kemiklerini bir araya toplayamayız mı sanıyor?
tr.fr: L'homme, pense-t-il que Nous ne réunirons jamais ses os?
tr.id: Apakah manusia mengira, bahwa Kami tidak akan mengumpulkan (kembali) tulang belulangnya?
tr.ur: کیا انسان یہ خیال کرتا ہے کہ ہم اس کی (بکھری ہوئی) ہڈیاں اکٹھی نہیں کریں گے؟
tr.bn: মানুষ কি মনে করে যে আমি তার অস্থিসমূহ একত্রিত করব না?
tr.de: Meint der Mensch (etwa), daß Wir seine Knochen nicht zusammenfügen werden?

verses.ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ

tr.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
tr.uz: Ҳа, Биз унинг бармоқ учларини ҳам асл ҳолига келтиришга қодирмиз.
tr.ru: Конечно! Мы способны восстановить даже кончики его пальцев (или сделать всего его пальцы одинаковыми, так что он не сможет пользоваться ими, как прежде).
tr.tr: Evet, Biz onu, parmak uçlarına varıncaya kadar bütün incelikleriyle yeniden yapmaya kadiriz.
tr.fr: Mais si! Nous sommes Capable de remettre à leur place les extrémités de ses doigts.
tr.id: Bukan demikian, sebenarnya Kami kuasa menyusun (kembali) jari jemarinya dengan sempurna.
tr.ur: ضرور کریں گے (اور) ہم اس بات پر قادر ہیں کہ اس کی پور پور درست کردیں
tr.bn: পরন্ত আমি তার অংগুলিগুলো পর্যন্ত সঠিকভাবে সন্নিবেশিত করতে সক্ষম।
tr.de: Ja doch! (Wir) haben die Macht dazu, seine Fingerspitzen zurechtzuformen.

science: Fingerprint ridges form in the womb between weeks 10 and 17 and stay the same for life. They differ between individuals, even identical twins.

Francis Galton's 1892 book “Finger Prints” established scientifically that they are permanent and unique, which opened the door to forensic identification. Before that, fingerprints were pressed into clay and used as personal marks in ancient Babylon and China.
The verse, in the context of resurrection, says God is able to put together even the banān, the fingertips: the finest and most individual detail of a person.

proof.title: Grew: the ridges
proof.text: Nehemiah Grew describes the ridges and pores on fingers and palms.

proof.title: Mayer: no two alike
proof.text: Johann Mayer states that no two people's fingerprint patterns are exactly alike.

proof.title: Purkinje: nine patterns
proof.text: Jan Purkinje sorts fingerprints into nine pattern types.

media.caption: Purkinje's nine fingerprint types.

proof.title: Galton: permanent and unique
proof.text: Francis Galton shows that fingerprints stay the same through life and are distinctive enough to identify people. The same year, Juan Vucetich in Argentina uses a bloody fingerprint to solve a murder.

media.caption: A fingerprint: a plain whorl.

proof.title: Twins
proof.text: Studies of identical twins find their fingerprints are similar but different.

fits: Banān (fingertips) names the part of the body whose ridges identify each person.
The verse stresses God's power to shape even the finest detail.
gaps: The context is resurrection, not identification.
Banān can mean fingers or fingertips generally.
Fingerprints were pressed into clay as marks in ancient Babylon and China, so their individuality was not hidden.
Science has not proved that no two prints are identical, only that none has been found.

media.caption: A fingerprint: a plain whorl pattern.
A fingerprint: a central pocket loop whorl.

facts.title: The Splitting of the Moon
facts.hook: “The Hour has come near, and the moon has split.” A sign in the Islamic tradition, not a scientific discovery.
facts.scienceHeading: What we can and cannot say

verses.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

tr.en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
tr.uz: Соат (қиёмат) яқинлашди ва ой бўлинди.
tr.ru: Приблизился Час, и раскололся месяц.
tr.tr: Kıyamet saati yaklaşır, ay yarılır; onlar bir delil görünce hala yüz çevirirler ve: "Süregelen bir sihir" derler.
tr.fr: L'Heure approche et la Lune s'est fendue.
tr.id: Telah dekat datangnya saat itu dan telah terbelah bulan.
tr.ur: قیامت قریب آ پہنچی اور چاند شق ہوگیا
tr.bn: কেয়ামত আসন্ন, চন্দ্র বিদীর্ণ হয়েছে।
tr.de: Näher ist die Stunde (des Gerichts) gekommen, und gespalten hat sich der Mond.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ

tr.en: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
tr.uz: Агар бир оят-мўъжизани кўрсалар, юз ўгирарлар, бу ўткинчи сеҳр, дерлар.
tr.ru: Когда они видят знамение, то отворачиваются и говорят: «Это - преходящее (или крепкое; или лживое) колдовство!».
tr.tr: Kıyamet saati yaklaşır, ay yarılır; onlar bir delil görünce hala yüz çevirirler ve: "Süregelen bir sihir" derler.
tr.fr: Et s'ils voient un prodige, ils s'en détournent et disent: «Une magie persistante».
tr.id: Dan jika mereka (orang-orang musyrikin) melihat suatu tanda (mukjizat), mereka berpaling dan berkata: "(Ini adalah) sihir yang terus menerus".
tr.ur: اور اگر (کافر) کوئی نشانی دیکھتے ہیں تو منہ پھیر لیتے ہیں اور کہتے ہیں کہ یہ ایک ہمیشہ کا جادو ہے
tr.bn: তারা যদি কোন নিদর্শন দেখে তবে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয় এবং বলে, এটা তো চিরাগত জাদু।
tr.de: Und wenn sie ein Zeichen sehen, wenden sie sich ab und sagen: "Fortdauernde Zauberei."

science: Muslim scholars have long held that this event happened at Makkah during the Prophet's ﷺ lifetime, when the disbelievers demanded a sign: the Moon appeared split in two, with the mountain seen between the two parts. It is reported in Sahih al-Bukhari (for example 3636, 3637 and 4864) and in Sahih Muslim, from companions including Anas ibn Malik and Abdullah ibn Masʿud.

This is a miracle in the Islamic tradition: an event given as a sign, not a natural process. Science studies repeatable natural processes, so it can neither prove nor disprove it, and this app does not claim otherwise.

You may have seen posts claiming that “NASA found a crack across the Moon” that proves it. No NASA statement supports that. The long channels seen on the Moon are lunar rilles, ordinary features made by ancient lava flows and faulting. We do not use that story.

proof.title: The reports
proof.text: Several companions, including Abdullah ibn Masʿud and Anas ibn Malik, narrate that the Moon appeared split in two at Makkah.

proof.title: The collections
proof.text: Al-Bukhari (d. 870) and Muslim (d. 875) record the reports in their Sahih collections, which Muslim scholars grade as authentic.

proof.title: What the Moon's channels really are
proof.text: Apollo and Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter photographs show that the Moon's long channels (rilles) are old lava channels and fault valleys. They are not a split and are unrelated to this event.

media.caption: Hadley Rille, a lunar lava channel (Apollo 15).

fits: Verse 54:1 states the event in the past tense right after “the Hour has drawn near”.
54:2 says that when they see a sign they turn away and call it magic. Classical commentaries connect this to the Makkans calling it sorcery.
gaps: No physical test is possible: it is a reported miracle, accepted on the strength of transmission.
A minority of scholars read inshaqqa as a future sign of the Last Hour.
Historians do not generally accept any independent record outside the Muslim sources.
Claims that NASA photographed the split are false.

media.caption: The Full Moon.
NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter: a tour of the Moon's surface.
media.credit: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center/David Ladd & Ernie Wright

sources.title: Lunar rilles (what the Moon's “cracks” really are)

facts.title: The Romans Will Win
facts.hook: A prophecy about a superpower war: the defeated Romans (ar-Rūm, the Byzantines) “will overcome”, within “three to nine years”.

verses.ar: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ

tr.en: The Byzantines have been defeated
tr.uz: Рум мағлуб бўлди.
tr.ru: Повержены римляне
tr.tr: Rumlar en yakın bir yerde yenildiler. Onlar bu yenilgilerinden bir kaç yıl sonra galip geleceklerdir. İş, eninde sonunda Allah'a aittir. İşte o gün, inananlar, istediğine yardım eden Allah'ın yardımına sevineceklerdir. O güçlüdür, merhametlidir.
tr.fr: Les Romains ont été vaincus,
tr.id: Telah dikalahkan bangsa Rumawi,
tr.ur: (اہلِ) روم مغلوب ہوگئے
tr.bn: রোমকরা পরাজিত হয়েছে,
tr.de: Die Römer sind besiegt worden

verses.ar: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ

tr.en: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome.
tr.uz: Яқин ерда. Ва улар мағлубиятларидан кейин тезда ғолиб бўлажаклар.
tr.ru: в самой низкой (или ближайшей) земле. Но после своего поражения они одержат верх
tr.tr: Rumlar en yakın bir yerde yenildiler. Onlar bu yenilgilerinden bir kaç yıl sonra galip geleceklerdir. İş, eninde sonunda Allah'a aittir. İşte o gün, inananlar, istediğine yardım eden Allah'ın yardımına sevineceklerdir. O güçlüdür, merhametlidir.
tr.fr: dans le pays voisin, et après leur défaite ils seront les vainqueurs,
tr.id: di negeri yang terdekat dan mereka sesudah dikalahkan itu akan menang
tr.ur: نزدیک کے ملک میں اور وہ مغلوب ہونے کے بعد عنقریب غالب آجائیں گے
tr.bn: নিকটবর্তী এলাকায় এবং তারা তাদের পরাজয়ের পর অতিসত্বর বিজয়ী হবে,
tr.de: im nächstliegenden Land. Aber sie werden nach ihrer Niederlage (selbst) siegen,

verses.ar: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.en: Within three to nine years. To Allah belongs the command before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
tr.uz: Саноқли йилларда. Ундан олдин ҳам, кейин ҳам барча иш Аллоҳдандир. Ўша кунда мўминлар шодланурлар.
tr.ru: через несколько (от трех до десяти) лет. Аллах принимал решения до этого и будет принимать их после этого. В тот день верующие возрадуются
tr.tr: Rumlar en yakın bir yerde yenildiler. Onlar bu yenilgilerinden bir kaç yıl sonra galip geleceklerdir. İş, eninde sonunda Allah'a aittir. İşte o gün, inananlar, istediğine yardım eden Allah'ın yardımına sevineceklerdir. O güçlüdür, merhametlidir.
tr.fr: dans quelques années. A Allah appartient le commandement, au début et à la fin, et ce jour-là les Croyants se réjouiront
tr.id: dalam beberapa tahun lagi. Bagi Allah-lah urusan sebelum dan sesudah (mereka menang). Dan di hari (kemenangan bangsa Rumawi) itu bergembiralah orang-orang yang beriman,
tr.ur: چند ہی سال میں پہلے بھی اور پیچھے بھی خدا ہی کا حکم ہے اور اُس روز مومن خوش ہوجائیں گے
tr.bn: কয়েক বছরের মধ্যে। অগ্র-পশ্চাতের কাজ আল্লাহর হাতেই। সেদিন মুমিনগণ আনন্দিত হবে।
tr.de: in einigen Jahren. Allah gehört der Befehl vorher und nachher. An jenem Tag werden die Gläubigen froh sein

science: In 614 CE Sasanian Persian armies took Jerusalem from the Byzantine (Roman) Empire, and by 619 they had conquered Egypt. The Byzantines seemed finished. In Makkah the small, persecuted Muslim community sympathised with the Christian Romans against the Persians.
From 622 Emperor Heraclius launched a counter-offensive. At the decisive Battle of Nineveh in 627 the Persian army was crushed, and by 628 the war was over: the reversal the verses foretold.
“Adnā al-arḍ” can mean “the nearest land” or “the lowest land”. The Dead Sea region, the lowest exposed land on Earth (about 430 m below sea level), lay in the war zone.

proof.title: Jerusalem falls
proof.text: Persian armies capture Jerusalem. The Armenian historian Sebeos and the Greek Antiochus Strategos record the massacre and the loss of the True Cross.

proof.title: Egypt is lost
proof.text: The Persians finish conquering Egypt, the granary of the Byzantine Empire.

proof.title: Heraclius strikes back
proof.text: Emperor Heraclius counter-attacks through Anatolia and Armenia, as the chroniclers Theophanes and the Paschal Chronicle record. In December 627 he wins at Nineveh.

media.caption: The Sasanian Empire at its height, about 621 CE.

proof.title: Peace and the Cross

facts.title: The Ant Who Warned Her Colony

science: Ants live in colonies of thousands to millions and coordinate through chemicals, touch and sound. Alarm chemicals send nestmates rushing to shelter or to defend it, and trail chemicals mark the way to food.

The word “pheromone” was coined in 1959. In 1962 E. O. Wilson showed how fire ants lay a chemical trail from food to the nest. In 1965 Hubert Markl found that leaf-cutter ants trapped underground rub a ridge on their bodies to make sounds that call nestmates to dig them out.
Some ants build enormous nations: one supercolony of Argentine ants stretches about 6,000 km along the European coast, from Italy to Spain.

proof.title: Pheromones get a name
proof.text: Peter Karlson and Martin Lüscher coin the word “pheromone” for chemical signals passed between members of one species, the same year Adolf Butenandt identifies the first one, bombykol, from silk moths.

proof.title: Wilson: the fire-ant trail
proof.text: E. O. Wilson shows that fire ants lay a chemical trail from food to the nest, and that nestmates follow it and reinforce it. He also studies how alarm chemicals send a colony into action.

proof.title: Markl: ants that call by sound
proof.text: Hubert Markl finds that leaf-cutter ants trapped underground rub a ridge on their bodies to make sounds that call nestmates to dig them out.

proof.title: The Ants
proof.text: Bert Hölldobler and E. O. Wilson publish The Ants, a 700-page account of ant societies, their communication and alarm signals. It wins a Pulitzer Prize in 1991.

proof.title: One colony, 6,000 kilometres long
proof.text: Argentine ants along the European coast, from Italy to Spain, are shown to belong to a single supercolony that recognises its own members (Giraud and colleagues).

fits: One ant warns the others to go into their homes: real ants give alarm signals that send nestmates to shelter or to defend it.
The verse speaks of ants as a people (an-naml) with dwellings, matching colonies with nests and shared rules.
gaps: The verse is part of a story in which Solomon understands the ant's words; it is not offered as a lesson in ant biology.
Namlah is a grammatically feminine noun, so “she said” does not by itself show that the speaker was a worker.
Ants do not speak in words: their signals are chemical, touch and sound.

science: A forager that finds rich flowers returns to the hive and performs a waggle dance: a figure-of-eight run. The angle of the straight run, measured against the vertical comb, tells the direction of the flowers relative to the Sun, and its length tells the distance.

Karl von Frisch decoded the dance in the 1940s and shared the 1973 Nobel Prize for it. In 2005 harmonic radar tracked bees leaving the hive after watching a dance and showed that they really flew to the place the dance described.
Bees find their way by the Sun, by the pattern of polarised light in the sky and by landmarks, and can forage several kilometres from the hive.

proof.title: Von Frisch decodes the dance
proof.text: Karl von Frisch trains marked bees to feeders at set distances and directions and watches their dances back at the hive, until he can read direction and distance from them. He publishes the result in 1946.

media.caption: Karl von Frisch.

proof.title: Nobel Prize
proof.text: Von Frisch shares the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Konrad Lorenz and Nikolaas Tinbergen for discoveries about animal behaviour.

proof.title: A robot bee
proof.text: Axel Michelsen and colleagues build a mechanical dancing bee. Real foragers watch it and fly to the feeder it indicates.

proof.title: Radar tracks the recruits
proof.text: Using harmonic radar, Joseph Riley and colleagues follow individual bees leaving the hive after watching a dance and show that they fly to the place the dance described.

fits: “Paths” (subul) “made easy” (dhululan) matches flight paths that other bees can follow, described in the dance.
The bee is “inspired” (awḥā), matching a largely inborn behaviour: bees can dance without being taught.
The instruction to go out and eat from all the fruits matches foraging trips.
gaps: The dance is not mentioned in the verse; linking “the ways of your Lord made easy” to it is a modern reading.
Classical commentators read the ways as the paths back to the hive, or as the ways God has smoothed for the bee.
Waḥy (inspiration) is a religious word; science calls the behaviour instinct and does not address it.
Other honeybee species dance differently, and some bees do not dance at all.

science: A swarm of desert locusts can hold 40 to 80 million adults per square kilometre. Each locust eats about its own weight in food a day, so one square kilometre of swarm eats what 35,000 people would in a day, and swarms can be carried up to about 150 km in a day on the wind.
For a long time solitary grasshoppers and swarming locusts were thought to be different animals. In 1921 Boris Uvarov showed they are one species in two forms, called phases.

In 2009 a team led by Michael Anstey and Stephen Simpson showed what flips the switch: crowding, especially the touch of other locusts on the hind legs, raises serotonin in the nervous system. Within about two hours a shy solitary insect becomes gregarious, and blocking serotonin stops the change.

proof.text: Boris Uvarov shows that solitary grasshoppers and swarming locusts are one species in two forms, which he calls phases.

proof.title: Touch is the trigger
proof.text: Stephen Simpson and colleagues show that a solitary desert locust turns gregarious when it is repeatedly touched on the hind legs, as it is in a crowd.

proof.title: Serotonin flips the switch
proof.text: Michael Anstey, Stephen Simpson and colleagues show that crowding raises serotonin in the locust's nervous system, and that blocking serotonin stops the change: within about two hours a shy insect becomes gregarious.

proof.title: A modern upsurge
proof.text: The worst desert-locust upsurge in decades hits East Africa, Yemen and South Asia. Satellites, ground surveys and aerial spraying, coordinated by the FAO, are used to track and counter it.

fits: “Locusts spread out” pictures a huge crowd dispersing in all directions, just as a swarm looks.
7:133 lists locusts among the plagues that strip the land, and a swarm does exactly that.
gaps: 54:7 is a simile about the Day of Judgment, not about locust biology.
The serotonin switch is a modern discovery; the verse says nothing about it.
Locust plagues were well known in the ancient Near East, so the picture was familiar.
